main_text.p: מַעַט Parum, Paucum, Parvum esse vel fieri, Minui, Diminui: Infinit. לְמִי מְעַט Secundum diminui, Levit.25.16. id est, Pro paucitate, Infinitivus loco nominis. Futur. יִמְעַט Minor fuerit, Exod.12.4. יִמְעֲטוּ Diminuentur, Iesa.21.17. Pih. מִעֵט Minuere, Diminuere, Praeter. מְעַטוּ Minuent, Eccl.12.3. Hiph.Praet. וְהִמְעִיטָה Et diminuat, Levit.26.22. &c.

מְעַט m. Paucitas, Parum, Paucum, Minimum; Paucus, Parvus: אֲנָשִׁים מְעַט Homines pauci, Nehem.2.12. Interdum dicitur de pauco temporis; ut Psalm.37.10. Jerem.51.33. & alibi. מְעַט מְעַט Paulatim, Exod.23.30. כִּמְעַט Vel Minimo, Momento, Propemodum, Fere, Fermè, Penè, Psalm.81. v.15. Plural. מְעַטִים Pauci, Eccles.5.1.

מָעֻךְ Compressit: Particip. Praeteritum, וּמָעוּךְ Et compressus, Levit.22.24. Foemin. מְעוּכָה Compressa, Impressa, vel Infixa in terram, 1.Sam.26.7. Pyh. Praet. שָׁם מָעֲכוּ Illic compressa fuerunt ubera tua, Ezech.23.3.

מָעַל Praevaricatus est: Construitur cum Praepositione ב, & fere semper habet adjunctum Nomen conjugatum: Praeter. מָעַל בִּי Praevaricatur contra me, Ezech.17.20. מָעַל מַעַל Praevaricatus est praevaricatione, Iosh.22.20. &c.
מַעַל m. Praevaricatio: Aff. מַעֲלָם Praevaricationem eorum, Ezech.39.26.
מְעִיל masc. Pallium, Exod.28.31. Aff. מְעִילוֹ Pallii ejus, 1.Sam.15.27. Plural. מְעִילִים Pallia, 2.Sam.13.18. Aff. אֶת־מְעִילֵיהֶם Pallia sua, Ezech.26.16.
מַעַן לְמַעַן Propter, cum Verbo Infinitivo: Cum Fu-turo, Propterea, Ut: לְמַעַן הָבִיא Propter adducere, Ut adducat, Genes.18.19. לְמַעַן תּוֹרָא Ut timearis, reveren-

page.notes: Hebrew words and vowel points are transcribed from a small, low-resolution scan and may contain errors; the most doubtful forms are not individually marked and should be checked against a higher-resolution image. The final line's Hebrew (למען תורא) and the tail of the last entry are especially uncertain. The catchword "reveren-" is repeated after the last full line as printed. Printed "Ecclef." was rendered as "Eccles." for the long-s rule; the abbreviation is otherwise kept as printed.
